name: frequency1
description: Frequency of first calibration value. Set to 0 if not used.

name: frequency2
description: Frequency of second calibration value. Set to 0 if not used.

name: calibrationApplied
description: Set to 1 if calibration has already been applied or 0 if trace is not corrected.

name: headerBlockType
description: Must be 42 (hex) or 65 (decimal) for sensor info header.
